turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I'm not here to perform for you, Hale. My position is the zero comes off, and you answer my question. Who decided?
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
No. You're stalling, and I'm writing that down. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I mean it at this volume, Hale. That's three times you've dodged one question, and the principal's office is down the hall. Who decided on the zero?
No. Twenty minutes, Hale, and I'm going upstairs next unless you give me a name. Who entered the zero, and when?
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.
November 3, five days after he handed it in, and nobody called me. Did you enter it yourself, and did you speak to Owen before you did? Procedure 4.2 says I hear from you before any mark goes in.
